# Models

The models configuration of a host: the path of an `llm.routes/1` document and, for each role Loom asks a model for (the agent and the classifier), the model that serves it, named by a route or by an endpoint and model id of that document.

`loom.models` is one of loom's bounded contexts. [All domains](./index.mdx).

## Types

### `ModelRole`

`loom.models.ModelRole` is one of `agent` and `classifier`.

### `ModelsConfig`

`loom.models.ModelsConfig` is a record of two fields:

- `routes` — `String`
- `roles` — `List<loom.models.RoleModel>`

### `RoleModel`

`loom.models.RoleModel` is a record of two fields:

- `role` — `loom.models.ModelRole`
- `model` — `String`

One of the types above is reached by nothing else in this system: `loom.models.ModelsConfig`. No entity, view, command, event, error or crossing names it, so it is either vocabulary something outside this specification uses or a leftover — and only a person can tell which.
